<!-- Thanks for contributing! Keep PRs small and focused. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

## What does this change?

Briefly describe the change and link any related issue (e.g. "Closes #12").

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / improvement
- [ ] Content or data (precedent, element, cost figure, source)
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (typecheck + build)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New numbers, claims, or real-world examples are **accurate and sourced** (nothing invented)
- [ ] Any images I added are **openly licensed or used with permission**, with attribution in the `credit` field
- [ ] The change is focused and matches the surrounding code/content style
